doc.description:
Board-specific firmware configuration for the Holybro Kakute H743-Wing.
Captures the on-board peripherals whose wiring is fixed by the board and would otherwise be missed: - micro-SD card is on SDMMC2 (ChibiOS SDCD2), not the SDCD1 default. - on-board barometer BMP280 is on the internal I2C4 bus at 0x76.
The IMUs and CAN are added in the airframe (see notes below): - ICM42688-P on SPI3, CS = SPI_SLAVE2 (PE12) -> fully supported via the imu_icm42688 module. Use this as the primary IMU. - BMI088 on SPI1 (accel CS SPI_SLAVE0/PC8, gyro CS SPI_SLAVE1/PC9): Paparazzi currently only ships an I2C transport (bmi088_i2c); a SPI transport (bmi088_spi) does not exist yet, so the BMI088 cannot be used over SPI without adding that driver. Fly on the ICM42688. - OSD AT7456E on SPI2 (CS SPI_SLAVE3/PB12): no Paparazzi driver, unused. - CAN1 (FDCAN1, PD0/PD1, on-board transceiver): enable USE_CAN1 and a DroneCAN/uavcan module in the airframe for the companion link.
Example airframe snippet: <module name="imu_icm42688"> <configure name="IMU_SPI_DEV" value="spi3"/> <configure name="IMU_SPI_SLAVE_IDX" value="SPI_SLAVE2"/> </module> <module name="logger_sd_chibios"> <configure name="SDLOG_SDIO" value="SDCD2"/> </module>
